dsh-enhance
The missing conversation power-up for DeepSeek Harness ✨
New-conversation naming, file drag references, edit-and-resend for the last prompt, a message timeli
ne, and a draggable floating ball with chat-width control for the DSH Web GUI.

✨ Features ·
📥 Install ·
🚀 Quick Start ·
🛠️ Development ·
❓ FAQ
> I use DeepSeek Harness every day. New sessions need useful names; finding a message in a long thre
ad means scrolling; referencing a file means copying its path; correcting the last prompt should be

quick.
>
> So I built **dsh-enhance**: it leaves DSH’s native structure alone and just makes the dai
ly actions smoother.
## ✨ Features
| | Feature | What you get |

| ✏️ | **New conversation naming** | Name it from the workspace `+` before creating it |
| 📎 | **Fil

e drag reference** | Drag a file or folder into the composer as an `@path` |
| ✍️ | **Edit & resend*

* | Stop a turn, edit the sent prompt inline, and send it again |
| 📍 | **Message timeline** | Scan,

preview, and jump through long threads |
| 🫧 | **Floating ball & width** | Everyday tools one click
away; 38–90rem live width |

The GIFs below are recordings from DSH. The UI may look different with another theme or window size.
### ✏️ New Conversation Naming
**Name it before you create it.** Clicking `+` on a workspace title row opens a naming dialog instea
d of creating another “New Session”.

- Type a name and press Enter; **Skip naming** keeps the native one-click flow.
- The name is writte

n as the conversation title; before the first turn, the sidebar blank row shows it.
- Turn **Name ne
w conversations** off in the quick panel to restore the native behavior.
### 📎 File Drag Reference
**Drop a file, get a reference.** Open the **Files** tab in the right sidebar and drag a file or fol
der row into the composer:

- The composer shows **Drop to reference <name>**; on release it inserts an `@relative/path` chip.
-
The file is not moved, copied, or rewritten; the model reads it through its file tools when you sen

d.
- Paths are relative to the conversation workspace root; paths with spaces use `@"..."`.
- Folder

s are inserted with a trailing `/` (`@path/`) so the model can browse the directory.
- The composer
gets an accent outline while dragging; dropping elsewhere inserts nothing.
### ✍️ Edit & Resend the Last Prompt
**Stop, tweak, send again.** When the conversation is idle, a **pencil** appears beside Copy in your
last sent prompt’s action row. Clicking it expands the prompt into a full-width inline editor with
mpt’s action row. Clicking it expands the prompt into a full-width inline editor with Cancel / Send:

- Edit the text, then click **Send** (or press Enter; Shift+Enter inserts a line, Esc cancels).
- Se
nding forks the conversation **before the turn that carried that prompt** — including the queued inb

ox copy — sends the edited text into the new branch, and opens it.
- The branch keeps the earlier hi
story and title. The original is archived when archiving succeeds; otherwise it remains in the conve

rsation list.
- Attachments are not resent; the editor warns when the original prompt had one.
> DSH's log is append-only and has no public "rewrite this message" call, so the edit is a **fork be
fore the turn + resend**, not an in-place mutation. The new conversation gets a new Session ID.
### 📍 Message Timeline
**Never lose your place in a long thread.** A thin fixed timeline sits on the right:
- One node per question/answer turn; each node is anchored on the user question and covers the assis

tant reply.
- Hover a node for the question, turn, and a content preview.
- Click a node to jump to

the question; the top/bottom buttons jump to the first/last.
- The `>` button collapses the rail; tu
rn it off/on in the quick panel.
### 🫧 Floating Ball & Chat Width
**Everyday tools, one click away.** Drag the floating ball anywhere; click it to open the quick pane
Everyday tools, one click away.** Drag the floating ball anywhere; click it to open the quick panel:
| Tool | What it does |

| **Chat width** | Live 38–90rem, default **48rem**, one-click reset |
| **Message timeline** | Togg

le the right timeline rail |
| **Native turn navigation** | Hide the horizontal turn rail DSH draws

on the right (on by default) |
| **Name new conversations** | Toggle the workspace `+` naming dialog

|
| **Floating ball position** | Reset to the default corner |
Width syncs both ways with DSH’s native drag handle: dragging the handle updates the panel value; ad
justing the panel writes DSH’s width preference (`dsh.conversation.contentWidth`).

t-sidebar **Files** tab (included in the official composition).
